entries.title: Tree field picker redesign
entries.summary: on forms, Tree fields now open as a dropdown that shows one level at a time: drill into a branch to see its sub-options and use Back to go up, instead of scanning the whole hierarchy expanded at once. A new **max selections** field setting caps how many values can be picked — set it to 1 for single-select.

entries.title: Redesigned Report Builder
entries.summary: build custom reports in a full-screen workspace with a live preview: drag-and-drop columns, filters with real value pickers, grouping with date bucketing, pivots, nested rows, sorting with row limits, undo/redo, and an example gallery. Describe a report in plain English and the AI builds or refines it; schedule sends, share links, dashboard widgets, and the activity log are managed from tabs inside the builder, and exports run in the background.

entries.title: Site builder for Program Sites
entries.summary: design your Program Site visually with a live preview: choose the Portal or Marketing site layout, apply structural templates and WCAG-audited color schemes, build the landing page from twelve content sections, turn on public Speakers, Agenda, and Exhibitors pages with shareable profile pages and branded social cards, edit the menu and footer, hide the sign-in card on promotional sites, and start custom pages from ten ready-made templates including Call for papers and Evaluator guide.

entries.title: Connect AI assistants to Sessionboard
entries.summary: step-by-step guides for connecting AI assistants to your org through the Sessionboard MCP server, with the correct server URL for US, EU, and Middle East regions, OAuth sign-in, example prompts, and troubleshooting.

entries.title: Contracts with Docusign (Early Access Beta)
entries.summary: send Docusign templates pre-filled with contact, account, session, and event data straight from a contact, account, group, or pipeline record; statuses update automatically, signed PDFs land on the record, a signed agreement can auto-advance the pipeline, and signers can sign from their portal.

entries.title: Surveys (Early Access Beta)
entries.summary: score sessions, speakers, posters, and subsessions while the event runs, with named reviewer stations, an open link, per-session QR codes, and a printable committee packet. New in this release: checkbox and yes/no question types, conditional questions ("if bias = yes, describe"), and per-option result charts. Request access from **Sessions → Evaluation → Surveys**.
